title: Sprint lightboard: inference & console midweek sync (Miranda Li personal notes)
content:
Purpose:
- Quick mid-sprint alignment between serving runtime, infra and console owners. Keep it 30 minutes, action-focused. This is my personal prep + follow-up tracker for the huddle.

Timebox: 30m (strict)
Date: 2026-03-12 (midweek sync slot)
Attendees (invite list): Eshan, Rhea, Omar, Kai (ops), Lina (SRE), me. If someone is blocked, ask for 5m deep-dive afterwards.

Pre-read (2 mins):
- Latest deploy/rollout notes (linked)
- Incident digest (last 7d): elevated tail latency on us-west nv4 pool
- Console bug: save template crash for >100kb payloads (PR awaiting review)

Snapshot metrics to call out (one-liners):
- P50 / P95 generation latency (api-hosted-prod): 38ms / 220ms (spike observed Tue 15:10-15:40)
- Error rate: 0.14% (5xx), mainly async KV cache misses growing during burst test
- Dedicated capacity utilization (reserved cluster 12): 73% steady, spiky bursts hitting 95% during peak tests
- Console API errors (templates): 4/day last 48h, reproducible w/ large payloads

Agenda (30m):
0-2m: quick round – any hot outages or blocks not on agenda?
2-8m: Rollout health & risk flags (Eshan) – short bullets: ongoing A/B, fallback behavior, any canary failures
8-15m: Infra capacity & autoscaling behavior (Lina/Omar) – note recent nv4 pool throttling, suggested short-term mitigations
15-22m: Console UX + API issues (Rhea) – crash repro, PR review bottleneck, temporary workaround for templates
22-28m: Action item go-round / owners commit (all)
28-30m: Parking lot + quick sync time for Friday if needed

Discussion prompts / my notes (to ask during the sync):
- For the nv4 spikes: what was the request mix? any long-context jobs? Can we throttle heavy batch requests earlier?
- Are prefix caches being warmed correctly after model switch? If not, what's the manual mitigation for canary failures?
- PR blocking console fix: who can triage review today? If not reviewed by EOD, enable temp size-limit on UI to prevent crashes.

Risks I want explicit commitments on:
- Canary rollback plan if P95 > 300ms for 10m across regions (who triggers, who validates)
- If reserved cluster >90% for >5m, autoscale policy should add burst nodes + throttle non-critical tenant tests

Action items (live tracker) – fill in owners and due dates during meeting:
- AI-01: Add a short circuit to batch admission policy to reject / queue >2s batched jobs during peak. Owner: Omar. Due: 2026-03-15.
- AI-02: Review console template PR #458 and merge or comment with blocking items. Owner: Rhea. Due: 2026-03-12 (EOD).
- AI-03: Add a dashboard tile for KV cache miss rate per model variant + alert at 1.5% increase. Owner: Lina. Due: 2026-03-14.
- AI-04: Draft a short rollback checklist for canaries (who runs, smoke checks, post-rollback metrics). Owner: Eshan. Due: 2026-03-13.
- AI-05: Temporary UI limit to 80kb on template payloads until PR merged; apply policy and update docs. Owner: Miranda Li. Due: 2026-03-12 (today).
- AI-06: Postmortem stub for Tue nv4 spike with timeline + earliest repro steps. Owner: Omar + SRE. Due: 2026-03-16.

Parking lot (defer to Friday deep-dive if needed):
- Longer discussion on quantization profile changes and customer impact (needs data from Optimize team)
- Proposal: add model-variant labels into console routing dropdown (design work needed)

Notes to self (non-share):
- Bring up possibility of a short-term model-split: route heavy batch calls to dedicated cluster to avoid affecting hosted latency. Evaluate cost tradeoffs—talk to finance.
- Reminder: ping Sarah in product about the customer complaint thread (templates failing in onboarding flow).
- If Rhea can't clear PR, escalate to feature lead to unblock console release.

Follow-up format I will use after meeting (send in thread):
- TL;DR 3 bullets (health, biggest blocker, 3 actionable commits)
- Inline action item table (copy paste AI list above)
- Attach simple metric screenshots + links (P95 graph, cluster util)

Draft message to send right after meeting (copyable):
"Thanks everyone — short notes from today
1) Health: P95 spike isolated to nv4 pool during stress tests, we have mitigation plan;
2) Blocker: console template PR needs review, temporary UI cap being applied;
3) Actions: Omar to add batching circuit, Lina to add cache-miss alert, Eshan to write canary rollback checklist. See action list below for owners & due dates.
"

End of scratchpad. Will update AI rows during the meeting and move to shared agenda doc when stable.

Extra: quick list of links to paste in meeting chat:
- Rollout notes: https://confluence.redwood/INF/rollouts/2026-03-10-canary
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/458
- Incident digest: https://confluence.redwood/INF/incidents/2026-03-09-nv4-spike
